high_level_description: This image is a social media post from Yahoo Finance, showcasing the most craved snacks by U.S. region based on a survey conducted by Coca-Cola. The post is visually engaging with a map of the United States divided into regions, each highlighted in different colors to represent the most popular snack in that area. Title and Source: The title at the top reads "MOST CRAVED SNACKS BY U.S. REGION." The source is mentioned as "COCA-COLA COMMISSIONED SURVEY," with a sample set of 2,000 U.S.
